data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure step for step (Airport tab, type airport, select suggestion, pick dates, optional sort) with the same four parameters. The only weaknesses are that it doesn't say how dates are picked (calendar gridcells) or what the sort options are, and it adds an unneeded "open homepage" step, so a builder would have to fill in some details.
